# The walked world: Kanto and the Sevii Islands, made by tools/frlg_world.py from the pret/pokefirered
# decompilation (do not edit by hand - edit World/patches.txt and run the tool again).
# Grid: . walk  # solid  g tall grass  c cave floor (wild Pokemon)  v < > ledges  w water (Surf)  W waterfall
#       T tree to Cut  R rock to smash  B boulder (Strength)  1-4 spin tiles (up, down, left, right)  0 spin stop  D door
# door = x y action (walk into it)   sign/spot = x y (face it, press Enter)
# npc = x y sprite facing sight action   (sight > 0: a trainer who walks up when you pass)
#   actions: talk|text  trainer|Story stage|before|after  fight|Name|Pidgey 9, Rattata 8|before|after
#            give|text/more text|Item|count|flag|after  heal|text  shop|text
#   legend|Species|cry text (npc sprite "mon:Species": gone once caught)  raid (the Raid Den)
#   tower (the Battle Tower)  trashcan|flag  quiz|question|yes or no|flag|trainer  exchange|give item|get item|text
#   encounter|Species|level|flag|text|item needed|text without it  ferry|text
# item = x y Name [count] [hidden]      gate = x y flag (solid until the flag is set)
# if = flag / unless = flag   (on the line after an npc, door, spot or item: only while...)
#   flags: anything set by "flag|name" or a gift, "badge:Cascade", "stage:Cerulean Gym", "item:Bicycle", "!" = not
# map keys: indoor  dark (Flash)  bike (Cycling Road)  town  fly = x y  weather  over (drawn over people)  objects = sprites
sprites = player leaf rival oak oldman agatha balding_man beauty bill black_belt blaine blue boy brock bruno bug_catcher cable_club_receptionist camper captain celio channeler chef clerk clipboard cooltrainer_f cooltrainer_m crush_girl cut_tree daisy erika fat_man fisher fossil gba_kid gentleman giovanni gym_guy hiker item_ball koga lance lass little_boy little_girl lorelei lt_surge man mg_deliveryman misty mom mr_fuji nurse old_amber old_man_1 old_man_2 old_woman picnicker pokedex poke_maniac policeman prof_oak pushable_boulder rocker rocket_f rocket_m rock_smash_rock ruby sabrina sailor sapphire scientist swimmer_f_land swimmer_f_water swimmer_m_land swimmer_m_water trainer_tower_dude tuber_f tuber_m_water union_room_receptionist woman_1 woman_2 woman_3 worker_f worker_m youngster hg_elm hg_silver hg_steven hg_kurt hg_goggles_man hg_little_boy hg_maizie hg_cap_boy hg_straw_hat hg_mom hg_pigtails hg_young_man hg_boy hg_blond_boy hg_spiky_man hg_girl hg_jasmine hg_bun_woman hg_bald_man hg_woman hg_pryce hg_granny hg_aunt hg_falkner hg_mr_pokemon hg_swimmer_m hg_swimmer_f hg_glasses_man hg_blue_hair hg_bugsy hg_whitney hg_morty hg_bruno hg_erika hg_old_white hg_clair hg_will hg_koga hg_chuck hg_karen hg_lance hg_twintails hg_surge hg_sabrina hg_misty hg_headband_girl hg_janine hg_brock hg_blaine hg_blue hg_red hg_officer hg_monk hg_rocket_f hg_rocket_m hg_ariana hg_archer hg_cook hg_flame_man hg_cyclist hg_kimono_girl hg_lass hg_captain hg_dark_girl hg_spiky_punk hg_eusine hg_elder hg_tank_man hg_pink_girl hg_green_girl hg_navy_girl hg_cap_girl hg_hat_girl hg_grandpa hg_giovanni hg_bearded_man hg_sage hg_petrel hg_proton hg_worker
